steps.caption: FlickOS starts from its own boot menu.
steps.alt: The boot menu: the FlickOS logo above three entries, the first highlighted in amber.

steps.caption: The splash while it starts: the cursor in the logo blinks.
steps.alt: The FlickOS logo and name on a dark grey screen.

steps.caption: The login screen. Here the name is typed for you; Log in asks for the password next.
steps.alt: A login box on a blue background with circles, the user name sam typed in.

steps.caption: At the first login, Welcome shows where everything is.
steps.alt: The Welcome window with cards: choose your desktop, all settings, Wi-Fi, keyboard shortcuts, install software and more.

steps.caption: The desktop: the Redmond layout in the Light style, FlickOS 3.0's default. Hold Super to see every keyboard shortcut.
steps.alt: A blue desktop with the FlickOS logo in the middle and a light panel along the bottom.

steps.caption: The start menu: your apps, your folders, Settings and the power buttons.
steps.alt: The start menu open above the panel, apps on the left and Sam Taylor's folders, Settings and Software on the right.

steps.caption: Settings, Media Controls: media buttons in the panel and a sound spectrum, both off until you turn them on.
steps.alt: The Media Controls page with five switches, all off.

click.label: Turn on media controls in the panel

steps.caption: Then some music: the Music folder, opened from the start menu.
steps.alt: The file manager showing the Music folder with one song.

steps.caption: While it plays, the panel has its buttons and the title, and the bars appear just above the panel.
steps.alt: VLC playing the song; the panel shows previous, pause and next buttons, the song's title and a bars button, with spectrum bars above the panel.

steps.caption: The bars move with the sound.
steps.alt: Spectrum bars above the panel moving with the music.

steps.caption: The spectrum can also be a ring in the middle of the screen, and take every color.
steps.alt: The Media Controls page with the controls, the spectrum, the ring and rainbow colors turned on.

steps.caption: The ring sits behind your windows and clicks go through it.
steps.alt: A ring of bars in every color around the FlickOS logo, moving with the music.

steps.caption: Settings, Desktop Layout & Style: the whole desktop changes with one click.
steps.alt: The Desktop Layout & Style page with three layouts: Redmond, chosen, Cupertino and Traditional.

steps.caption: Cupertino: a bar at the top and a dock at the bottom. The music controls came along.
steps.alt: The desktop with a bar along the top, a dock at the bottom and the Settings window open.

steps.caption: And the Dark style. Every layout works with every style, and it all goes back with one click in Settings.
steps.alt: The Cupertino layout in dark colors, the dock at the bottom and the rainbow ring around the logo.

end.title: FlickOS 3.0, coming with Debian 14
end.text: This tour shows a test version; things will change before the release. FlickOS 2 is ready today.
